versions.changelog:
li-maestro-evaluate v1.0.3

- Added two analysis modes: MVTM Checklist (minimum viable threat model) and Full 10-phase assessment, selectable at session start.
- Extended pre-engagement protocol to include analysis mode selection and dual (MAESTRO + China-specific) decision tree.
- Updated outputs to reflect mode selection, with MVTM producing dedicated checklist files.
- Documentation (README.md, SKILL.md) revised for clarity, new features, and regulatory alignment.
- CHANGELOG.md file introduced; skill-card.md removed.

li-maestro-evaluate 1.0.2 Changelog

- Clarified and expanded documentation, especially regarding conversational workflow, assessment phases, and target systems.
- Detailed pre-engagement questions and decision trees for tailored threat modeling depth.
- Expanded description of output formats, file structures, and automatic per-run directory creation.
- Improved explanation of the MAESTRO threat modeling process tailored for agentic AI systems and OpenCode Skills.
- Now includes mapping of AI risk classification to Chinese AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0 within generated reports.

li_maestro_evaluate 1.0.1

- Implements interactive Q&A threat modeling based on CSA MAESTRO for agentic AI systems and OpenCode Skills.
- Guides users through a 10-phase risk assessment, with detailed conversation architecture and pre-engagement protocol.
- Supports output of risk assessments and AI risk classifications in multiple formats: .md, .docx, .xlsx.
- Adds automated completion for Phases 6-10, with user option to auto-complete and review at the end.
- Integrates MAESTRO layered/threat model and China AI Security Governance Framework risk mapping.  
- Generates timestamped, per-run output directories with all related reports for each evaluation.
